description: Show an actionable distinction between empty accessible journals and active filters.
steps: Open Stock Movements with an account that has no accessible journal movements
expected: The page shows an explanatory empty-state message without claiming journal records were deleted.

name: MEMS AppDeploy administrator page
description: Provide a super-administrator-only MEMS deployment launchpad.
steps: Sign in as MEMS platform super administrator
Open Platform > AppDeploy dashboard
expected: A MEMS-only read-only AppDeploy launchpad appears with working external console and app links.

name: Inspect effective access without changing existing permissions
description: Shows the current user assignments, effective permissions, duty conflict warnings, and audit review using the existing administration design.
steps: Sign in as an organization user with security-role administration permission
Open Organization administration > Security roles > Review access
Select Inspect user access and security events
Select an organization user from the list and inspect their permission sources
expected: The inspector lists only the organization's users, shows their job and direct permissions and recent security history, and provides no action that changes permissions.

name: Temporary password change is required before protected operations
description: Verifies a temporary credential must be changed through the existing flow before privileged pages or business operations are available.
steps: Sign in with a freshly issued temporary password for an organization user
Confirm the existing Set your own password screen is shown
Change the password to a new valid password
Confirm the normal organization landing page becomes available
expected: Normal business pages remain inaccessible before a verified password change; after the Firebase password update the existing landing page loads.

name: Organization logo belongs only to its own tenant
description: Check that an organization keeps its own registered or uploaded logo and cannot display a foreign tenant logo after changing accounts.
steps: Sign in as an organization super administrator and open Organization administration > Branding
Upload a valid organization logo and confirm it is shown in the branding preview and organization header
Sign out and sign in as a user of a different organization
Open the second organization's header and branding page
expected: Each organization displays only its own approved or uploaded logo (or a neutral placeholder if its stored reference is invalid). The first organization's logo never appears for the second organization.

name: Organization administrator membership limited to three
description: An existing super administrator can add or promote users up to three designated administrators and receives a clear error at the limit.
steps: Sign in as an organization super administrator and open Organization administration > Users
Review the administrator counter and select Add administrator while a slot is available
Create an administrator with a valid company email and strong temporary password
Open another existing user and attempt to assign administrator rights after three designated administrators exist
expected: The newly created administrator appears in the user list, the count does not exceed 3/3, and a fourth administrator assignment is rejected without changing user permissions.

name: Remove administrator rights without removing the account
description: An administrator can safely demote another administrator while retaining the account, and cannot remove the last active administrator.
steps: Sign in as an organization super administrator and open Organization administration > Users on a phone
Open another administrator and choose Remove administrator rights, then save the role change
Confirm the user remains listed with standard security role
Attempt to remove administrator rights when only one active administrator remains
expected: The demoted user remains an organization member, their elevated rights no longer apply, and the last active administrator cannot be removed or disabled.

name: Founder account remains permanent super administrator
description: Creator of an organization cannot be deleted, disabled or demoted while other super administrators remain editable.
steps: Sign in as a different organization super administrator and open Organization administration > Users
Open the original organization creator
Verify the creator is labeled Protected and their role and active status cannot be changed
Verify Delete is unavailable for the creator
Open a nonfounder administrator and confirm the ordinary removal-of-rights option remains available
expected: The original creator retains active super-admin status, even if other administrators exist, while other administrators can still be managed normally.

name: Personal setup persists and restores last page
description: Individual user can choose any corporate theme preset, including dark choices, and resume the last organization page.

Select Royal blue or another organization preset, and Last visited page, then save
Confirm the selected neutral colors apply while the organization's main brand color remains unchanged
Navigate to a permitted organization page and log out
Sign back in and verify the previous page is restored
Open My setup and confirm the saved choices persist
expected: The selected neutral color scheme and startup page persist only for that user, and the restored page is accessible and within the organization.

Open Organization administration > Users and scroll

expected: The fixed footer remains visible on both organization workspaces with the small MEMS platform logo and publisher text, and does not cover page controls.

name: Personal screen-time tracker with enforced breaks
description: Enable individual MEMS wellbeing breaks, track active foreground usage, and enforce a timed server-backed lock.

Enable screen-time tracking and mandatory breaks, select 15 minutes work and a 1-minute break, and save
Actively use MEMS until the chosen duration is reached
Verify an automatic logout and a timed MEMS rest message appear
Attempt login before the break ends, then again after it expires
expected: Foreground active usage is counted, the configured break triggers a server-enforced lock with remaining time, and MEMS access resumes only after the timer expires.

name: Weekly Off reactivation requires explicit account confirmation

Tick Enable my Weekly Off lockout, confirm its impact and save the setup
Confirm the selected weekday is now enforced on that user account only
expected: Existing archived weekly selections remain inert until explicitly reactivated, while users can re-enable the full-day rest lockout for their own accounts.

name: Another organization user can sign in during someone else's wellbeing lock
description: Health lockout applies to one user identity, not a device, login form, organization or platform-wide session. Clear another user's countdown and login warning when switching accounts.

Confirm A's countdown and warning are not shown for B and user B can sign in normally
Check B's session remains open while A's break timer is still running
expected: The account-specific countdown prevents only A from signing in during A's break; user B is not blocked or automatically logged out by A's lock event.

name: Weekly Off timer and other-user sign-in remain account specific
description: A weekly rest day blocks only the account that knowingly enabled it, with a visible countdown and working account switch on a shared device.
covers: weekly server lockout via session and guards

Confirm MEMS signs user A out and shows a per-user countdown to next midnight when A's email is entered
Choose Sign in with another account and authenticate user B during A's Weekly Off
Confirm B is able to enter MEMS and use authorized organization modules without A's countdown or logout
Confirm a legacy countdown stored before this reactivation does not block a different user or an inactive account
expected: Only an account that newly enabled Weekly Off is denied access on its chosen weekday, until local midnight; colleagues can log in normally.

Open the monitored row in the mobile full-screen detail view, attach a second photo and submit Open progress with comment, then submit Closed; verify the photo is retained and a source-linked Chat update is created for each change and requester acknowledgement is still needed
Requester acknowledges closure; verify closure confirmation appears in Chat and Calendar, while accepted or created action deadlines remain represented
Send an internal email with a monitored action, recipients and required description; update progress from My To-do and verify a Re: update arrives on the original email thread

Compose a separate email with Reply, Reply All and Delete allowed by default; check that reading, composing and replying all have transparent body backgrounds and theme-contrasting text, including older HTML formatted in black and dark background, and disable Reply All on another email to ensure backend rejects recipient reply-all
Create a calendar meeting with an action and accept it; update the assigned action and verify a dated activity entry is recorded on that event
Confirm a user outside the relevant organization, assignment or Chat room cannot view its monitored action or its Calendar milestone
expected: My To-do shows each owned or assigned action with one source-linked status/history, and Quick Calendar displays due/closure markers without generating duplicate actions. Updates notify the originating source while privacy and mail permissions remain enforced.

name: Inventory on hand: one action bar and one menu
description: The Inventory on hand page has no header block; the search box and one menu button are the action bar and the table fills the screen.
covers: warehouse choice in the table menu
steps: On a phone open Inventory Management > Inventory on hand
Confirm there is no title block, refresh button or warehouse dropdown above the table: only the search box with a menu button, one line with the row count, then the table to the bottom of the screen
Scroll the table: only the rows scroll, the search box and menu button stay on top, the page itself does not move
Open the menu: with more than one accessible warehouse a Warehouse list shows with a tick on the current choice; choose one and confirm the table and the row-count line follow
In the menu confirm Refresh, then Filters, Group by, Formula columns, Columns, Saved templates and Export Excel; use a filter such as On hand less than 10 and confirm the rows update
Tap a row and confirm the material opens as before
expected: The table has the whole screen, every choice sits behind the one menu button, and Excel downloads are still audited.

name: Material photos: take photo and gallery
description: On a phone, Take photo opens the camera and Gallery opens the picker; the saved photo or the reason it failed is shown right under the photo area.
steps: Install the latest Manufusion MEMS DEV Android APK (uninstall the older one first) and open a material that has no photo, as a person with the inventory edit right for that warehouse
Tap Take photo: the camera app opens; take a photo and accept it; confirm Saving photo appears and then the photo shows as the cover
Tap the gallery button and choose two photos at once; confirm all are added and the count updates, up to eight photos
Cancel the camera and the picker once each; confirm nothing is added and no error shows
Choose a file that is not a photo; confirm a clear message appears directly under the photo area
Confirm each added photo has an audit entry (inventory.material.photo.add) and that a person without the inventory edit right sees no photo buttons
expected: Photos are added from the camera and the gallery, any problem is shown next to the buttons, and every change is audited.

name: Stock Take: separation of duties, and test mode for the super administrator
description: Nobody verifies, approves or posts a PI they counted or submitted; the screen says so before the tap. Only the organization super administrator, while platform test mode is on, may do it alone.
steps: As the person who counted a PI and submitted it for posting, open it while it is Awaiting posting approval; confirm Approve posting is greyed out and a note says you cannot approve it and that another person with the posting approval permission must
Sign in as a different person with the posting approval permission at that warehouse; confirm Approve posting works and, for a PI with one line, the confirmation says '1 line will be released'
Confirm the same holds for Accept verification and Post & reconcile when you counted the PI

On the development server, as the organization super administrator with platform test mode on for the organization, open a PI you counted or submitted; confirm the buttons are active and a note says test mode lets you complete the step alone
Approve it; confirm it moves to Approved for posting and the audit trail holds testmode.controls_bypassed with inv.stocktake.approve_independence
Switch test mode off, or use a person who is not the super administrator; confirm the buttons are greyed out again and the server refuses the action
expected: Nobody can verify, approve or post their own PI and the screen says why before they tap; only a super administrator in platform test mode may, and every use is audited.

name: Material detail: one menu and a two-column grid that scrolls
description: On a phone, the material detail tabs show only the header with Edit and one menu button, the tabs, and a two-column grid of boxes that scrolls on its own; notes, key information and links are in the menu.
steps: Open a material from Inventory on hand and go to Inventory Information: confirm the boxes are two per row, the page itself does not scroll, and only the boxes move when you swipe
Tap the menu (three dots) in the header: confirm it shows the physical location (link or delink a bin), notes and Refresh
Open Stock Control: confirm the long note is not on the page but in the menu under Notes, and that all fifteen boxes scroll while the header and tabs stay in place

Open Replenishment: confirm the strategy, what it does, and the Stock Control values are in the menu under Key information; with a strategy that is missing a required level, confirm a dot on the menu button and the box marked Required
Open Procurement Information: confirm Display currency is chosen in the menu and the note about stored prices is under Notes

Open Movements: confirm the search box takes the full width, the menu button in the header opens the table tools (filters, group by, formula columns, columns, saved templates, Export Excel) together with the note, and a single row reads '1 row'
Tap Edit on Inventory Information: confirm the inputs are two per row, Cancel is an icon, Save stays in the header, and the Field guide is in the menu
Tap the small question mark on a box: confirm the explanation opens in a sheet and the box height does not change
expected: Every material detail tab has one menu, no notes or buttons crowd the page, and the boxes or table use the whole screen and scroll on their own.

name: Stock take: sessions first, Chart of Authority on variances, session progress report
description: A stock take starts with a session in Active sessions (configuration, warehouse, start, optional end, metrics). PI documents are created only inside an open session, variances are approved level by level under the Chart of Authority, and each session has a progress report.
steps: Open Inventory > Stock take: confirm the first tab is Active sessions, the header button is New session, and the PI documents tab has no New PI button
Tap New session and tap Create session with the form empty: confirm the problems list and red field messages; enter a start in the past and confirm it is refused
Fill name, configuration, warehouse, start now, an end in two days and the metrics; confirm the summary sheet and tick the acknowledgement; confirm the session opens as In progress
In the session tap New PI document and create a PI; if any material in the picked locations has no reconciled stock, confirm the PI is refused and the materials are named

Work a PI to Verified with a variance and submit it for posting: confirm a Chart of Authority card shows the variance value and the levels, and a person without the level's job role sees why Approve is disabled
Approve each level with the right people (or as super admin in test mode); confirm the PI becomes Approved for posting only after the last level, and Return sends it back to Verified with the reason

Open the session's Progress report: confirm completion, PI documents and locations against targets, accuracy, variance value against tolerance, time used, stage bars and the stage table with Excel download
Try Close session while a PI is open: confirm it is disabled; finish or disregard the PIs, then close with a reason and confirm the session drops off the active list
expected: No PI document exists outside a session, no variance posts without every Chart of Authority level approving, and the progress report shows the session's state against its metrics.

name: Stock take v2: PIs only inside sessions, CNT_SES_/PI_ codes, planned PIs, PDF, two accuracy KPIs, statistics
description: There is no PI documents tab: every PI sits in its session. Sessions are CNT_SES_ + 8 digits and PIs PI_ + 8 digits from database counters. The number of PIs comes from materials to count and materials per PI. Printing also downloads a PDF. Count and stock accuracy are separate, and Statistics covers a period or year to date.
steps: Open Inventory > Stock take: confirm the tabs are Active sessions, Statistics and Configuration (no PI documents tab); older PIs without a session are under the 'created before sessions' entry
Create a session with 18 materials to count and 4 per PI: confirm the form shows 5 PI documents and the new session code starts with CNT_SES_ followed by 8 digits
Create PIs in the session: confirm each is PI_ followed by 8 digits, shows 'This PI: n of 5', never repeats a location already on the session's PIs, and the sixth is refused
On a PI tap Print and download PDF: confirm a PDF named after the PI is saved with the count sheet (no system quantities) and the print dialog opens
Recount a PI where some recounts differ from the first count: confirm the Progress report shows count accuracy reduced by those recount errors and stock accuracy by the differences posted
Open Statistics: confirm it opens year to date from the financial year start, change the dates and tap Show, and download the by-session and by-month tables to Excel
expected: No PI exists outside a session, codes are sequential from the database, PI numbers follow the plan, and both KPIs and the statistics read correctly.

name: Stock take configuration: criticality, duration, automatic sessions at midnight, automatic closing
description: In a configuration the type comes first and gives the name. Optional criticality classes A to D can be chosen. There is a duration instead of a PI size. Periodic configurations create sessions automatically at midnight or manually. An automatic session needs its plan completed once before PIs. Sessions close themselves when all PIs are posted.
steps: Open a material > Inventory Information, tap Edit and set Criticality class to A; save

Stock take > Configuration > New config: confirm the type is first and the name follows it until you type; turn on Count by criticality and pick A and B; confirm there is no PI document size and Duration (days) is required
Turn on Periodic: confirm 'Sessions are created' must be chosen; choose Automatically and confirm a warehouse is required; save and reopen it to see Last created, Last session and Next due
Create a session manually from another configuration: confirm there is no End field, the End shown is start plus the duration, and PI documents only include materials of the chosen classes

After the next midnight (or a manual run of 'inv.stocktake-sessions' in the Automation Center) confirm a session 'Setup needed' exists for the automatic configuration, that New PI document is not offered, and Complete setup asks for name, materials, per PI and targets once
Post every PI document of a session: confirm there is no Close session button and the session closes on its own with the reason 'Closed automatically: 100% of the PI documents are posted.'
expected: Configurations carry criticality and duration, automatic sessions appear at midnight and must be completed before PIs, and sessions close only by themselves once fully posted.

name: Stock take session plan: All materials, no target fields, per-warehouse automation notice
description: Session plan and setup ask only materials to count (or All) and materials per PI; accuracy and variance are KPIs in reports. Automatic configurations warn that each warehouse needs its own, identifiably named configuration.
steps: New session: pick a configuration and warehouse, turn on All materials: confirm Materials to count fills with the warehouse's mapped materials (criticality and cluster applied) and is read-only, and the PI documents count updates
Confirm there are no count accuracy, stock accuracy or variance tolerance fields; the progress report still shows both accuracies and the variance value
Complete setup of an automatic session with All materials: confirm the same behaviour
New config, Periodic, Automatically, pick a warehouse: confirm the notice to create one configuration per warehouse and that the name becomes 'type – warehouse' until edited
expected: Sessions are planned from materials only, All counts on the server, and automatic configurations are named per warehouse.

name: Stock take configuration: cycle count full scope and period cycles; cluster stock take with several clusters
description: A cycle count is always periodic, asks whether the full scope must be counted in each session, and runs each cycle to the end of its period with the next cycle beginning there. A cluster stock take picks the warehouse first and then one or more of its clusters.
steps: New config, type Cycle Count: confirm Periodic is on and cannot be turned off, there is no Duration field, and 'Complete the full scope of materials within each session?' must be answered
Answer Yes, monthly, manual; create a session from it: confirm All materials is on and locked and the End shown is the 1st of next month at midnight
Make the same configuration automatic: confirm Next due is the end of the current period (for monthly, the 1st of next month)
New config, type Cluster Stock Take: confirm the warehouse is asked first, then its clusters are listed with Select all; pick two and save; PIs only take locations of those clusters
expected: Cycle counts follow their periods with an explicit full-scope choice, and cluster counts cover the chosen clusters of the chosen warehouse.

name: Stock take: automatic PI documents and independent count sheets with mandatory recount
description: A configuration says whether PI documents are created automatically. If so, all planned PIs are generated when the session is complete. Each session says how many sheets are printed per PI (_A, _B …); different people count them, and lines where they disagree must be recounted.
steps: Create a configuration with 'PI documents are created: Automatically'
Create a session from it with 2 PI documents printed per PI: confirm all planned PI documents appear at once and 'Create PI documents' shows no remaining
For an automatic session, complete its setup: confirm the PI documents are generated then
Tap Print and download PDF on a PI: confirm two PDFs PI_…_A and PI_…_B
Confirm printed (refused if the session has not started), submit sheet _A as one person, then try sheet _B as the same person: confirm it is refused; submit _B as another person
At verification confirm the Sheet A and Sheet B columns, the 'Sheets differ: recount' ticks that cannot be cleared, and that Accept verification refuses if those lines are not recounted
expected: PI documents are generated per configuration, each sheet is counted independently, and any disagreement forces a recount.

name: Stock take: sessions close automatically; automatic PI generation problems are shown and retried
description: A session closes on its own as soon as all its PI documents are posted and no more can come (planned number reached, locations exhausted or end date passed). Opening Stock take, a posting or the nightly run triggers it. When automatic PI generation fails, the reason stays on the session until it is fixed.
steps: Post every planned PI document of a session: confirm it moves to Closed with 'Closed automatically: 100% of the PI documents are posted.'
For a session past its end date whose created PIs are all posted, open Stock take: confirm it closes

Create a session from an automatic-PI configuration in a warehouse whose materials have no opening stock: confirm the red notice names the materials and stays when you reopen the session; post opening stock and tap Create PI documents
expected: Sessions never need closing by hand, and a failed automatic generation always explains itself.

name: Stock take: accept-and-post, recounts instead of edits, closed PIs hidden, cycle daily sessions and PI release
description: After counting there is one Accept step. With no variance it posts and closes the PI. With a variance it goes for Chart of Authority approval, and the last approval posts. Counts cannot be edited; recount lines or the whole PI instead. Closed PIs leave the active list. Cycle counts run one session or a session per day, with PIs all at once or each day, and show the target PIs per day.
steps: Count a PI with no differences and accept it: confirm 'Accept & post' posts and closes it, and it leaves the session's list (toggle Show closed PI documents to see it)
Count a PI with a difference: confirm 'Accept & send for approval', then the last approver sees 'Approve & post' and the PI is posted on approval
Confirm there is no Edit counts button and Print is not offered after counts are submitted; use Full recount with a reason and confirm a recount PI is created and the original is closed as Recounted
Cycle Count config, one session, PIs each day: confirm the session shows Target PIs per day and 'Create today's PI documents' creates only today's share; the nightly run adds each day's share

Cycle Count config, a session each day (automatic): after midnight confirm a session for the day; set up the first one with the whole cycle's materials; confirm later days are set up automatically with an even share and never repeat a location
expected: PIs close in one accept step or on the last approval, closed PIs disappear from the active list, and cycle counts are spread across days.
